Randomized with seed 12345

UserAuthentication
  with valid credentials
    logs in successfully
    returns an auth token
    sets the session cookie
    records the login timestamp
    sends a welcome notification
    updates last_seen_at field
  with invalid credentials
    raises AuthenticationError
    does not return a token
    does not set a session cookie
    increments the failed attempt counter
    logs the failed attempt to audit table
    returns a 401 status code
  with expired token
    raises TokenExpiredError
    clears the session
    returns a 401 status
  with revoked token
    raises TokenRevokedError
    does not allow access to protected resources
    removes token from valid tokens list

OrderService
  #create_order
    with valid items
      creates the order record in database
      charges the customer credit card
      sends confirmation email with order details
      decrements inventory count for each item
      assigns a unique order number
      sets order status to pending
    with out-of-stock items
      does not create the order
      returns descriptive stock error message
      does not charge the customer
      sends a restock notification to admin
    with invalid price
      raises PriceValidationError
      does not persist anything
  #cancel_order
    when order is pending
      cancels successfully
      issues full refund to original payment
      sends cancellation email with confirmation
      releases reserved inventory
    when order is shipped
      cannot cancel
      returns already_shipped error code
      suggests return process instead
  #update_order
    with valid changes
      updates item quantities correctly
      recalculates total price including tax
      re-validates stock availability

PaymentProcessor
  #charge
    with valid card
      returns successful charge object
      stores transaction id in database
      triggers payment success webhook
      records charge in audit log
    with declined card
      raises PaymentDeclinedError
      does not store transaction
      notifies customer of decline
    with network timeout
      retries three times with backoff
      raises PaymentTimeoutError after exhausting retries
      logs all retry attempts
  #refund
    for valid charge
      issues full refund to card
      updates transaction record status
      sends refund confirmation email

NotificationService
  #send_email
    with valid recipient
      delivers email via SMTP
      records delivery in log
      returns delivery status code
      stores message id for tracking
    with invalid email address
      raises InvalidEmailError with details
      does not attempt SMTP delivery
      logs the invalid address
  #send_sms
    with valid phone number
      sends message via SMS gateway
      records message id in database
      returns gateway response code
    with invalid phone number
      raises InvalidPhoneError
      does not consume message credits

AuditLogger
  #log_event
    records event type and timestamp
    stores user id with each entry
    serializes metadata to JSON column
    flushes to database within 100ms
